segments.name: Direct Sales
segments.description: Sells the Company's wines and related services directly to consumers through tasting rooms, wine clubs, online sales, events, and catering.
segments.evidence: Direct Sales include retail sales in the tasting rooms, wine club sales, internet sales, on-site events, kitchen and catering sales and other sales made directly to the consumer without the use of an intermediary, including sales of bulk wine or grapes.

segments.name: Distributor Sales
segments.description: Sells the Company's wines to third-party distributors and wine brokers at wholesale rates for resale.
segments.evidence: Distributor Sales include all sales through a third party where prices are given at a wholesale rate.
